Digital•Digital  & Smart  Manufacturing : The digital industry  group  
continued  to lead in investment,  with a total value  of over Baht 
612.0 billion  from 119 projects . In particular,  data center  businesses  
have become  essential  infrastructure  supporting  the growth  of the 
digital  economy,  driven  by cloud  services, AI development,  and big 
data processing .
•Smart  & Sustainable  Industry : Investor  interest  continued  to 
increase,  with 402 promoted  projects,  up 49% YoY, totaling  Baht 
37.6 billion,  an 81% YoY growth . Most  investments  focused  on 
business upgrades  to enhance  efficiency through  automation,  
robotics,  and digital systems,  as well as the use of renewable  
energy  and environmental  impact  reduction,  which  will strengthen  
the long-term competitiveness  of Thailand’s  industrial  sector.
•Industry  Outlook : Thailand  remains  one of the key investment  
destinations  for China  within  the ASEAN region,  particularly  in 
projects  related  to alternative energy,  electric  vehicles,  and 
industrial  estates . However,  Chinese  investment  in Thailand  
experienced  a slowdown  during  the first six months  of 2025  due to 
global  economic volatility  and uncertainties  surrounding  global  
economic and monetary  policies . Nevertheless,  a slight  recovery  in 
Chinese  investment  was observed  in Q3/2025 , reflecting  Thailand ’s 
potential  to attract long-term investment  from China  across various  
industrial  sectors.
